title: Avro Lancasters ME473 and ND572
memorial_details: description: THIS DISPLAY STANDS AS A MEMORIAL TO/ F/SGT ARTHUR HENDERSON/ AND/ SGT ROBERT CHARLES BANKS/ LISTED MISSING FOR OVER 50 YEARS. WHO ARE NOW/ PEACEFULLY LAID TO REST/ IN CAMBRIDGE CITY CEMETERY/ ALSO IN MEMORY OF/ (Names/ KILLED IN THE COLLISION OF TWO LANCASTERS/ OVER RUSKINGTON FEN 2nd MARCH 1945
